verdict.rationale: NY DTF is an online tax-services platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only human-facing Online Services features. Probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec, and the /e-services/ transaction paths are robots-disallowed. Nothing in the pack documents an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
